limits.value: up to 40 requests per minute (RPM) for most models, per account; no per-token billing; the account's own limit is shown in the top-right of the dashboard

free_tier.stated: free tier with no per-token billing, rate limited to up to 40 requests per minute (RPM) for most models; each account's own limit is shown in the dashboard
free_tier.notes: the FAQ states only the per-minute figure, up to 40 requests per minute for most models; it states no per-day request figure; the site's runtime copy file names 'Up to 40 rpm' and '10,000 requests per day' and the dashboard rate-limit chip renders only the per-minute value; the phone verification dialog lists 'Unlimited API requests without daily limits' as a benefit of verifying; whether a daily cap applies to an unverified account and not to a verified one is unverified: behind a sign-up

identity_cost.detail: an NVIDIA account (email) plus a one-time password sent to a phone number before an API key can be generated; the phone form refuses numbers located in AF, BD, BY, CU, IR, KZ, KG, KP, PK, RU, SY, TJ, TZ and UZ; no card required; the phone form is shown only to an organization owner whose account is unverified, and a member who is not the owner counts as set up without it, but a member still needs the organization's API key permission (canGenerateAPIKey), otherwise the dialog shows 'API Access Restricted by your Organization' with a choice of another account or the account admin; whether the key service enforces the OTP for a member is unverified: behind a sign-up

reliability_note: the phone one-time-password step fails for some numbers with 'invalid' or 'exceeded limits' errors; NVIDIA's pinned forum post of 2026-02-17 states verification on build.nvidia.com has been challenging and routes failures to help@build.nvidia.com; the phone form validates a number with libphonenumber isValid only and drops the listed locations, and it offers a Phone Call channel after three SMS resends when the runtime flag killswitches/otp/phone.enabled is true (read true on 2026-11-03), while the WhatsApp and WeChat channels are off (flags read false on 2026-11-03); whether the OTP service accepts VoIP or virtual numbers, and whether a call is delivered where SMS fails, is unverified: behind a sign-up
confidence_note: the 40 requests per minute figure and the no per-token billing statement are quoted from the build.nvidia.com FAQ; the no-credit-card statement is quoted from build.nvidia.com/llms.txt
